title: Over $30,000 in one quarter?
Charge GST on that sale
lead: Pass $30,000 of taxable sales in a single calendar quarter and you stop being a small supplier right then.

blocks.title: CRA's example: a new consulting business

blocks.text: Register within 29 days. Over $30,000 across 4 quarters but not one? You stop at the end of the next month.
